entities.name: Mercury
entities.desc: Mercury is the first planet from the Sun and the smallest, a rocky world with no moons.
entities.source: NASA NSSDCA Mercury Fact Sheet, https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/factsheet/mercuryfact.html (diameter = 2 x volumetric mean radius)

entities.name: Venus
entities.desc: Venus is the second planet from the Sun, a rocky world with a thick, hot atmosphere and no moons.
entities.source: NASA NSSDCA Venus Fact Sheet, https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/factsheet/venusfact.html (diameter = 2 x volumetric mean radius)

entities.name: Earth
entities.desc: Earth is the third planet from the Sun and the only known world with life. It has one moon.
entities.source: NASA NSSDCA Earth Fact Sheet, https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/factsheet/earthfact.html (diameter = 2 x volumetric mean radius)

entities.name: Mars
entities.desc: Mars is the fourth planet from the Sun, a cold rocky world with two small moons.
entities.source: NASA NSSDCA Mars Fact Sheet, https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/factsheet/marsfact.html (diameter = 2 x volumetric mean radius)

questions: Tell me about the Solar System.
lore.passage: The Solar System is the Sun and everything orbiting it. Mercury, Venus, Earth, and Mars are its small rocky inner planets; the outer planets are gas and ice giants.
lore.source: unverified: written from general knowledge for this example
